cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?
